claims.claim: Paper measures lifetimes within a high-spin triaxial band in133Ce and extracts a mean transition quadrupole moment Qt≈2.2 eb; it compares with self-consistent TRS calculations.
claims.boundary: It is a high-spin band study, not a whole-nucleus lifetime survey or direct gamma-rigidity measurement.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Gammasphere populated A≈132 Ce via100Mo(36S,xn)136−2xCe; about9×10^8 fold>5 prompt coincidence events over5 days.
claims.boundary: The 3n133Ce channel was relatively weak; event count is not 133Ce-specific effective counts.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: 133Ce sorting used Eγ1−Eγ2 matrices gated on422,488,643,888keV in-band transitions; relative channel populations132Ce:131Ce:133Ce=5:4:1 from low-lying normal-deformed lines.
claims.boundary: Population ratios are estimated from ungated matrix, not absolute cross sections or per-band efficiency-corrected yields.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Spectra projected for forward31.7–37.4°,90°, backward142.6–148.3° detector groups.
claims.boundary: Angular grouping is experiment-specific; no generic finite-array acceptance theorem or raw mask is supplied.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: DSAM Doppler-broadened line-shape analysis uses LINESHAPE; slowing recoil line shape depends on band/feeding lifetimes and unobserved feeding.
claims.boundary: A fitted line shape is model/feeding dependent, not direct τ independent of response assumptions.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: LINESHAPE uses Currie Monte Carlo:5000 recoil histories per time step0.001ps, scattering directions and low velocities; electronic/nuclear stopping use Ziegler powers and Monte Carlo.
claims.boundary: Producer code/raw velocity histories/stopping uncertainty are not supplied in paper.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Clean lower-energy in-band gates feed spectra; side-feeding intensities from same data agree with thin-target data Ref4 and are fixed; side feeding modeled as five-state rotational band with fixed inertia48 hbar² MeV−1.
claims.boundary: Fixed side-feeding intensity/inertia is a fit input; spins of side-feeding/triaxial bands estimated because no links to known low bands found.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Qt,QSF,contaminant/background/normalization variables fitted jointly forward/backward/90° with SEEK,SIMPLEX,MIGRAD; MINOS errors; errors below8% raised to minimum8%.
claims.boundary: Reported uncertainties include imposed floor; no full covariance matrix or raw spectra.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.boundary: Table uses mean lifetime τ(ps), not T1/2. Spins in parentheses are estimated high-spin band labels.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Weighted average Qt=2.2(.1) eb and Qt is fairly constant with estimated spin.
claims.boundary: Absolute Qt uncertainty≈10–15% from recoil stopping knowledge; weighted fit uncertainty alone is smaller.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: T(E2;I→I−2)=1.224×10^12 Eγ^5 / |<I0 20|I−2 0>|² Qt² with Eγ inMeV and Qt in eb; Clebsch-Gordan factor explicit.
claims.boundary: Transition strength convention is source equation; no conversion to B(E2) needed here.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Unobserved side-feeding transition energies estimated Eγ(SF)=hbar²(4I−2)/(2ISF) using fixed ISF=48 hbar² MeV−1; side-feeding lifetimes inferred from fitted QSF.
claims.boundary: These are modeled side-feeding energies/lifetimes, not directly observed transition clocks.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: TRS predicts negative-parity one-quasineutron νh11/2 bands with β2≈.19 and γ≈−30° minimum; another (νh11/2)^3 minimum at γ≈−73° at low frequency; Fig3(b) also has γ≈−83° triaxial and prolate SD β2≈.4 coexisting minima.
claims.boundary: Shape/configuration values are model predictions; paper’s abstract calls band triaxial but does not measure gamma directly.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: For nonaxial shapes Qt=Q20 cos(γ+30°)/cos30°. Assuming γ=−83° and Qt2.2(.1) gives Q20=3.2(.1) eb and β2=.186(.007) assuming no hexadecapole deformation.
claims.boundary: β2 conversion uses assumed theoretical gamma and no hexadecapole, not an independent static deformation measurement.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: TableII compares present133Ce triaxial Qt2.2(.1), β2=.186(.007), γ−83° with132Ce SD1 Qt7.4(.3),β2=.411(.021),γ0; prior133Ce triaxial≈2.3,β2≈.180,γ−80; SD values≈7.4–7.5 eb.
claims.boundary: Different bands/experiments and model gamma inputs; not all rows independent measurements.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: F(t) centroid-shift comparison shows much smaller133Ce triaxial Qt than132Ce SD1; top triaxial state lies slightly below Qt2.2 curve, possibly effective lifetime including side feeding enhanced by lower-gate selection.
claims.boundary: This caveat weakens treating every TableI state as pure in-band τ.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Co-populated132Ce SD1 and133Ce triaxial recoils share stopping conditions, enabling relative Qt comparison; absolute Qt values retain≈10–15% stopping uncertainty.
claims.boundary: Relative cancellation is conditional on same stopping and analysis; not proof of exact absolute deformation.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: In-band T(E2)≈35 W.u., below132Ce SD≈490 W.u. and132Ce normal ground band≈100 W.u.; authors infer triaxial structure less collective.
claims.boundary: These values aggregate derived strengths and model/Weisskopf conventions, not independent lifetimes for every state.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Paper cites Emediato1997 for low-spin νh11/2 T(E2)≈50 W.u. associated with β2≈.19,γ≈−30° minimum; this is a separate RDDS study and not a high-spin lifetime reused as same clock.
claims.boundary: Do not merge1997 low-spin states with these high-spin TableI states by νh11/2 label.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Authors conclude rotating triaxial shape at large gamma deformation with Qt≈2.2 eb; high-spin TRS also predicts coexisting superdeformed prolate minimum, but weak SD channel was not observed in this experiment.
claims.boundary: No direct chiral partner, tunneling, signed EM phase, or gamma-vibration/static proof.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: The negative-parity triaxial band is introduced as a rotationally aligned upper νh11/2 midshell configuration; TableI high-spin labels are parenthesized estimates because no linking transitions to known low-lying bands were found.
claims.boundary: Band letters/evaluation labels are not independent experimental configuration proof.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Prior SD lifetime measurements in132,133Ce used target-thickness Doppler broadening Ref18; this paper’s concurrent132Ce SD1 comparison is present data plus prior context, not one homogeneous dataset.
claims.boundary: Do not count all Qt rows as independent measurements.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis

claims.claim: Inverse-variance weighted mean of Qt values1.94(.10),2.65(.16),2.66(.21),2.15(.15) is2.199(.070) eb, rounding to reported2.2 eb; simple arithmetic mean is2.35 eb.
claims.boundary: This checks table arithmetic only; authors’ quoted .1 includes/reflects systematic stopping uncertainty, not reconstructed from table errors.
claims.lineage: Joss1998 primary Gammasphere DSAM/DBLS; no new reanalysis
